_comment: The MCP tool catalogue: names, titles, descriptions, input and output schemas and annotations for both profiles. The CLI's local stdio server mirrors the agent profile in packages/cli/src/commands/mcp-tools.ts; scripts/check-mcp-parity.mjs fails the build when they differ. Descriptions say what a tool does, not how an agent should behave (Anthropic and OpenAI directory review).

ref.description: The display ID on the V2 record: M-0219 for a memory, N-0042 for a note.

record.description: v2 for a statement on the V2 record; note for a note (a V1 memory in a space on the V2 record, never kept context); v1 for a saved memory in a space that hasn't switched.

text.description: The statement (v2) or the most relevant excerpt (v1).

url.description: Where a person can open it in Memax.

agent.instructions: Memax holds the memories a person and their team keep across agents. memax_recall and memax_search read them; memax_get opens one memory with its receipts and sources; memax_push proposes a memory (in spaces on the V2 record a person keeps it, in the agent or in Review); memax_capture saves session notes; memax_forget asks a person to forget a memory; memax_request_decision puts a question in front of the person. memax_list, memax_hubs, memax_hub_members and memax_topics browse spaces.

tools.name: memax_recall
tools.title: Recall memories
tools.description: Returns the memories relevant to a query from the spaces this connection can read. In spaces on the V2 record it returns kept memories, plus this session's own pending proposals marked proposed, and how each decision this connection asked for ended and what was forgotten since it read it (each once); without a query it returns a digest of each space (its latest compiled file, or its top kept memories by section, what changed since this connection was last seen, and the decisions it is still waiting on). In other spaces it returns ranked excerpts of saved memories.

query.description: What to look for, in natural language. Omit it for each space's digest.

topic_id.description: Restrict results to memories in this topic (UUID).

hub_id.description: Hub or space ID, slug, or 'personal'. Its results rank first; a space on the V2 record is read alone.

project_context.description: Current project context for relevance. Keys: repo (git remote URL), project (short name).

session_ref.description: The agent session this call belongs to. Proposals pushed with the same session_ref are included, marked proposed.

proposals.description: This session's own proposals, still waiting in Review.

digest.description: Without a query: one entry per space on the V2 record.

compiled.description: The space's latest compiled file (AGENTS.md, or the target delivered over MCP); sections are empty when it is present.

ref.description: The compile run, such as C-0881.

notices.description: What this connection should drop or recheck, each once: memories forgotten since it read them (or in a space it is connected to; every other tool's result carries these in _meta["app.memax/notices"] too), its writes put back in Review, and a space it is connected to moving to the V2 record (what it may do there now).

refs.description: The forgotten memories' display IDs; empty when a whole space was forgotten.

gates.description: Decisions this connection asked for in spaces on the V2 record: each answered, withdrawn or expired one once, and without a query the ones still waiting.

id.description: The gate's display ID, such as G-0012.

memory.description: The kept decision the answer became, such as M-0432.

url.description: Where a person can answer it or open it in Memax.

partial.description: Some spaces were left out because they didn't answer in time.

lexical_only.description: Results from spaces on the V2 record were matched by words, not by meaning.

tools.name: memax_search
tools.title: Search memories
tools.description: Searches kept memories and decisions in the spaces this connection can read and returns the matches with their display IDs. With include_notes it also searches notes: the V1 memories of spaces on the V2 record that the person it works for wrote, or that sit in a space they own. In spaces that haven't switched to the V2 record it searches saved memories.

query.description: Words or a question to search for.

space_id.description: Space ID, slug, or 'personal'. Omit it to search every space this connection can read.

include_notes.description: Also search notes, which are raw material and never kept context.

tools.name: memax_push
tools.title: Propose a memory
tools.description: Saves one piece of knowledge to a space. In a space on the V2 record it becomes a proposal that a person keeps: when the client supports elicitation the person is asked in the agent (keep, edit, or leave it as a proposal), otherwise it waits in Review; an agent connected at Write keeps its own first-party statements. In other spaces Memax saves and classifies it.

content.description: The knowledge to save. In a space on the V2 record, one statement of at most 2000 characters.

hint.description: Context that helps Memax process it, such as 'This is my resume' or 'Meeting notes from product review'.

initiation_type.description: How this save was initiated: human_requested_agent, agent_proactive, agent_automatic, import, or unknown. A tool call is never human_direct; that value is ignored.

project_context.description: Project context. Keys: repo (git remote URL), project (short name), branch.

hub_id.description: Target hub or space ID, slug, or 'personal'. Required for a team hub.

hub_reason.description: Why this belongs in the shared hub. Required for a team hub that hasn't switched to the V2 record; on the V2 record it becomes the receipt's reason.

section.description: Where it belongs in a space on the V2 record (default conventions). A memory in decisions is recorded as a decision.

sources.description: Where the statement comes from. Content from a URL, an email or an issue is external and always waits in Review.

ref.description: What a person sees, such as 'PR #212' or 'go.mod:14'.

uri.description: A URL or repository path, if any.

session_ref.description: The agent session this call belongs to. Recalls with the same session_ref include the proposal before it is kept.

status.description: saved (a space that hasn't switched), kept, proposed (waiting in Review) or note.

id.description: M-0219 on the V2 record; a UUID otherwise.

review_url.description: Where a person keeps the proposal.

assurance.description: For a keep confirmed in the agent: client_attested.

tools.name: memax_get
tools.title: Open a memory
tools.description: Returns one memory in full by its display ID (M-0219, with its space) or its UUID. On the V2 record it includes the receipts and sources.

id.description: A display ID such as M-0219, or a memory UUID.

space_id.description: The space of a display ID (ID, slug, or 'personal'). Optional with a UUID.

tools.name: memax_list
tools.title: List memories
tools.description: Lists memories newest first, a page at a time; pass the cursor from the previous page for the next one. In a space on the V2 record it lists kept memories, and topic_id may name a section.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous page.

hub_id.description: Hub or space ID, slug, or 'personal' to list.

topic_id.description: Topic ID (UUID) to filter by; in a space on the V2 record, a section (decisions, conventions, preferences or open_question).

tools.name: memax_hubs
tools.title: List spaces
tools.description: Lists the hubs (spaces) this connection can read, with their IDs, slugs, roles and memory counts, and for spaces on the V2 record this agent's autonomy there.

tools.name: memax_hub_members
tools.title: List space members
tools.description: Lists the members of a hub (space) and their roles.

hub_id.description: Hub or space ID, slug, or 'personal'.

tools.name: memax_forget
tools.title: Forget a memory
tools.description: Asks to forget a memory by ID. In a space on the V2 record an agent can't forget: this records a request that a person forgets it, or keeps it, on the web, and the result says where; until then it stays kept. In other spaces it deletes the memory.

id.description: A display ID such as M-0219, or a memory UUID.

space_id.description: The space of a display ID. Optional with a UUID.

reason.description: Why it should be forgotten, for the person who decides. In a space on the V2 record it goes into the request's receipt.

tools.name: memax_capture
tools.title: Capture session notes
tools.description: Saves a summary of a work session, with its decisions and learnings, as notes. In a space on the V2 record notes are raw material that Dream folds into proposals for Review; elsewhere each fact is extracted into its own memory.

decisions.description: Decisions made, such as 'Chose PostgreSQL over MongoDB'.

learnings.description: Things learned, such as 'pg_trgm is language-agnostic'.

tools.name: memax_request_decision
tools.title: Ask a person to decide
tools.description: Puts a decision in front of the person: a question with 2 to 4 options, shown in Memax. It returns at once with the request's ID, and the person's answer is saved as a memory that later recalls return. In a space on the V2 record the request is a gate, such as G-0012, that waits up to 7 days: the answer is kept as the person's decision, and this connection's next memax_recall returns it once. A client that supports multi round-trip requests may also show the question to the person in the agent.

question.description: The decision, as one user-facing question.

options.description: 2 to 4 mutually exclusive choices, as short labels.

context.description: Why it matters: tradeoffs, constraints, and a recommendation if there is one.

space_id.description: The space to ask in, by ID or slug, when it is on the V2 record. Without it, the space this connection writes to by default.

tools.name: memax_topics
tools.title: Browse topics
tools.description: Without topic_id, returns the topic tree with memory counts; with topic_id, the memories in that topic. In a space on the V2 record the topics are its sections (decisions, conventions, preferences, open_question) and their kept memories.

topic_id.description: Topic ID, or a section on the V2 record. Omit it for the whole tree.

hub_id.description: Hub or space ID, slug, or 'personal'.

chatgpt.instructions: Memax gives ChatGPT access to the user's personal and shared team knowledge. Use search_memories for retrieval, cite returned memory IDs and source metadata, use get_memory only when the full memory is needed, and only call save_memory or forget_memory when the user explicitly asks to change their Memax knowledge base.

tools.name: search_memories
tools.title: Search memories
tools.description: Searches the user's Memax memories with a natural language query across the spaces this connection can read and returns the matches with their IDs.

topic_id.description: Restrict results to memories in this topic (UUID).

project_context.description: Optional project context for relevance. Keys may include repo and project.

tools.name: get_memory
tools.title: Open a memory
tools.description: Returns the full content and metadata of one Memax memory by its ID.

id.description: The memory ID returned by search_memories.

space_id.description: The space of a display ID such as M-0219. Optional with a UUID.

tools.name: list_hubs
tools.title: List spaces
tools.description: Lists the personal and shared Memax hubs (spaces) the user can access, with their IDs, slugs, roles and memory counts.

tools.name: list_hub_members
tools.title: List space members
tools.description: Lists the members of a hub (space) and their roles.

hub_id.description: Hub or space ID, slug, or 'personal'.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.title: Browse topics
tools.description: Returns the topic tree of a hub (space) without topic_id, or the memories in one topic with it. In a space on the V2 record the topics are its sections.

topic_id.description: Topic ID to browse. Omit for the topic tree.

hub_id.description: Hub or space ID, slug, or personal. Omit to use the active hub.

tools.name: save_memory
tools.title: Save a memory
tools.description: Saves knowledge to the user's Memax. In a space on the V2 record it becomes a proposal the user keeps in Review.

hint.description: Optional processing hint such as meeting notes, decision, or personal preference.

hub_id.description: Target hub or space ID, slug, or personal. Omit to use the active hub.

hub_reason.description: Required when saving into a team hub that hasn't switched to the V2 record. Explains why the content belongs there.

section.description: Where it belongs in a space on the V2 record (default conventions).

tools.name: forget_memory
tools.title: Forget a memory
tools.description: Forgets a Memax memory by ID. In a space on the V2 record it asks the user to confirm on the web instead.

space_id.description: The space of a display ID. Optional with a UUID.
